    Multi-variable Groups Analysis with Statistical Tests and Plotting

    multi_var_groups_analysis.Rd

    This function performs a statistical analysis (ANOVA or non-parametric alternatives) on a given dataset grouped by specified variables, runs post-hoc tests for each interval, adjusts p-values, and generates a ggplot2 plot showing means with error bars and significance labels. It also calculates average fold changes between groups.

    multi_var_groups_analysis(
  data,
  stat_col,
  interval_col,
  group_col,
  parametric = TRUE,
  paired = FALSE,
  adj = NA,
  error = "sem",
  tx_pos = 0.02
)

    Arguments

    data

    A data.frame containing the dataset.

    stat_col

    A string specifying the name of the column with the response variable (numeric).

    interval_col

    A string specifying the name of the column representing intervals or time points (factor or character).

    group_col

    A string specifying the name of the grouping variable column (factor or character).

    parametric

    Logical; if TRUE, parametric tests (ANOVA, t-test) are used, otherwise non-parametric tests (ART-ANOVA, Wilcoxon/Kruskal-Wallis) are applied. Default is TRUE.

    paired

    Logical; whether to perform paired tests (currently not implemented in detail). Default is FALSE.

    adj

    Character or NA; method for p-value adjustment in post-hoc tests ("bf" for Bonferroni, "bh" for Benjamini-Hochberg, or NA for none). Default is NA.

    error

    Character; type of error bars to show on the plot: 'sem' (standard error of mean) or 'sd' (standard deviation). Default is 'sem'.

    tx_pos

    Numeric; position adjustment factor for placing significance text above error bars. Default is 0.02.

    Value

    An S4 object of class multi_var_groups_analysis containing:

    plot

    A ggplot2 object of the plotted means with error bars and significance annotations.

    statistic_group

    Summary statistics of the main group test (ANOVA or ART-ANOVA).

    test_name

    Name of the main statistical test used (character).

    statistic_post_hoc

    Data frame of post-hoc test results for each interval.

    stats

    Summary statistics of the data by group and interval.

    avg_FC_results

    Data frame with average fold change results between groups for each interval.

    Examples

    # Example usage
results <- multi_var_groups_analysis(data = my_data,
                                    stat_col = "measurement",
                                    interval_col = "timepoint",
                                    group_col = "treatment",
                                    parametric = TRUE,
                                    adj = "bh",
                                    error = "sem")
#> Error in assign(mname, def, where): cannot add bindings to a locked environment
print(results@plot)
#> Error: object 'results' not found
